name: tema-madya-cms-sekolahku
description: Tema Madya CMS Sekolahku — tema pihak ketiga dengan gaya editorial institusional modern.

scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run check:data && npm run check:style && npm run audit:icons && npm run audit:a11y && npm run audit:cms-data && npm run audit:assets && npm run audit:performance && npm run audit:cms-theme && node scripts/check-readability-contrast.js
scripts.format: biome format --write src/js src/css scripts tests playground
scripts.format:check: biome format src/js src/css scripts tests playground
scripts.build:theme: npm run validate && npm run build && node scripts/build-html.js
scripts.release: npm run check && npm run build:theme && node scripts/release.js
scripts.lint:js: biome lint src/js scripts tests playground
scripts.check:style: npm run check:style-config && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:php
scripts.lint:fix: biome lint --write src/js src/css scripts tests playground
scripts.fix: npm run format && npm run lint:fix && npm run format:php
